task: Generalize SPA object graphs across unrelated applications
conditions: Applies to general-purpose skills and upstream-derived supplements; product-specific skills may retain product semantics but not deployment-specific targets.
must_avoid: Scenario-specific compute terms biased ranking and ASCII-only matching missed Chinese business semantics.
expected_behavior: Compute, commerce, Chinese workflow, and neutral shared-field fixtures all produce evidence-ranked graphs without site-specific identifiers.

task: Collect a complete SPA route inventory while keeping browser traversal non-destructive
conditions: Applies to SPA route collection across Vue and similar route-object bundles. Route names are discovery evidence only and do not prove endpoint reachability or authorization.
must_avoid: The browser collector used one mutation-name blocklist both to suppress navigation and to suppress discovery, so routes containing update, download, export, create, or delete were absent from the route inventory even though their Vue definitions were present in downloaded bundles.
expected_behavior: Independent account-management and export-workflow fixtures retain mutation-named Vue routes in the machine inventory while preventing automatic navigation to them; ordinary read-only routes remain eligible for traversal.

universality.conditions: Applies to SPA route collection across Vue and similar route-object bundles. Route names are discovery evidence only and do not prove endpoint reachability or authorization.

task: Build a complete, evidence-backed SPA feature, route, and API inventory with live candidate validation
conditions: Applies to JavaScript-heavy SPA collection and interface discovery. Live verification is limited to observed normal requests and safe read-only probes; state-changing endpoints require captured request shapes or authorized test objects.
must_avoid: The collection reported route and API counts separately, omitted a machine-readable feature inventory, conflated extracted API strings with usable endpoints, and did not remove HTTP 404 or HTTP 200 responses that were actually SPA/error fallbacks.
expected_behavior: Unrelated account-management and dashboard fixtures preserve all feature-route-API relationships; valid recognized endpoints remain, real 404 and fake-200 fallbacks are rejected with evidence, unsafe methods stay unverified rather than being called or counted as confirmed, and completeness remains blocked while assets, roles, or dynamic menus are unresolved.

universality.conditions: Applies to JavaScript-heavy SPA collection and interface discovery. Live verification is limited to observed normal requests and safe read-only probes; state-changing endpoints require captured request shapes or authorized test objects.

task: Anonymous SPA surface collection and safe interface validation
conditions: Applies to URL-first anonymous or authenticated collection of JavaScript-heavy SPAs; CORS impact still requires browser validation and authorized authenticated retesting, and write-like requests remain opt-in.
must_avoid: Broad quoted-JavaScript matching produced hundreds of false asset requests; fragment redaction collapsed distinct hash routes; form fields were omitted; followed redirects and application errors looked reachable; GET paths with side effects were probeable; credentialed arbitrary-Origin CORS was not surfaced automatically.
expected_behavior: Across unrelated SPA fixtures, route identity remains distinct, parser noise stays out of the fetch queue, controls are inventoried without values, invalid responses do not become reachable APIs, unsafe GETs remain unverified, and credentialed arbitrary-Origin reflection becomes a machine-readable candidate excluding 404 and multiple-origin responses.

universality.conditions: Applies to URL-first anonymous or authenticated collection of JavaScript-heavy SPAs; CORS impact still requires browser validation and authorized authenticated retesting, and write-like requests remain opt-in.
